Prices and star ratings were read but are NOT published on the site (see flags F-02). Re-checked on 2026-11-14 in the integration session: product title, byline, spec table, category breadcrumb, also-viewed ASINs and short-link resolution matched the snapshot. Prices and ratings were read but are not published.
